parsed.reason: Description A describes a write-ordering problem: metadata is replaced before the blob, so a failed blob write leaves inconsistent state. Description B describes a mutable default argument `metadata={}` that is shared across calls and mutated by setdefault, causing wrong content-type recorded for later uploads. Different root causes, even though both sit in put().
